description: Introduction and overview of the Renault 5 Turbo (1980-1986): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Renault 5 Turbo was a mid-engine, rear-drive rally monster wearing an economy car's clothes. Built for Group B homologation with a turbocharged four behind the seats and box-flared arches, it won the Monte Carlo Rally. About 5,000 Turbo and Turbo 2 cars were built. Baseline facts: French rally car 1980-1986; ~5,000 built by Renault; Group B homologation..
